snippet.title: Kiss Or Kill - The Social VR Game Show
snippet.description:
Become a game show star in Kiss or Kill, the ultimate trivia showdown... live in Virtual Reality!

Kiss or Kill is coming soon to all VR headsets including the HTC Vive, HTC Vive Pro, Oculus Rift, Oculus Go and Samsung GearVR. Play live against friends and players around the globe. 

Will you become a game show star?

Kiss or Kill, developed by RLTY CHK.
